archival_memory.aging_concerns: Aging is definitely something I think about more these days. I’m in my mid-50s, and while I still feel young at heart, my body sometimes reminds me otherwise. It’s little things—aching joints, needing more rest, and just noticing that my energy levels aren’t quite what they used to be. Living in Kansas, where the seasons can be extreme, I have to adjust my routine to keep feeling my best. I used to take my health for granted, but now I’m much more intentional about what I do to stay strong and independent.
